title: 第146章 宗主季伯渊
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

张瑀点了点头，跟在她身后继续往上走去。

两人沿着长阶一路往上。

两侧的内门弟子纷纷躬身让路，没有人再多说一句话。

如果说刚才他们看张瑀的眼神是好奇和怀疑，现在那些眼神里就只剩下敬畏了。

一剑破开大师兄的三重护身罩——这份实力，别说是在内门弟子中，就算放在执事和长老里面，也不是人人都能做到的。

穿过最后一段石阶，前方出现了一座极其恢宏的大殿。

大殿坐落在山峰的最高处，三面都是悬崖，只有一条石阶通往殿前广场。

殿身共有五层，每一层都比前一层更加高耸，飞檐翘角，雕梁画栋，最顶层的檐角上挂着九串金铃，山风拂过的时候发出清越悠长的铃声。

殿门的正上方挂着一块巨大的匾额，上面用苍劲有力的古篆刻着三个大字——天符殿。

弹幕再次惊叹。

【这天符宗也太气派了吧！之前山门已经够壮观了，这大殿更夸张！】

【那些金铃的声音好好听，隔着屏幕都觉得心神安宁！】

【我感觉自己像个进城的土包子，看啥都新鲜！】

张瑀没有在意弹幕的惊叹。

他跟着宁霜序走进了天符殿。

殿内的空间比他想象的还要宽敞。

大殿中央铺着一条深红色的长毯，长毯两侧各站着几名穿着深蓝色执事服饰的中年修士。

大殿的最里端，摆放着七把紫檀木椅。正中央那把椅子比其他六把略高一些，椅背上雕刻着天符宗的宗门图腾——一道由无数细小符文组成的符箓图案。

此刻，那七把椅子上坐着七个人。

正中央的是一位老者。

看起来六十出头的模样，穿着一身紫金色的宗主袍服，头发花白，但精神矍铄。

一双眼睛深陷在眼窝里，瞳色是一种罕见的深棕色，看人的时候仿佛能把人看透。

他左右两侧各坐着三位长老，有男有女，年龄从四十多岁到七十多岁不等。

每个人身上散发出来的灵力波动都极其浑厚，至少都是金丹期。

坐在宗主左侧第一位的是位白发苍苍的老者，脸型瘦削，颧骨高耸，一双眼睛不大，但闪烁着冷厉的光芒。

他身上的灵力波动在七人里仅次于宗主。

这位就是天符宗的大长老——也是韩奕的师父。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhang Yu nodded and continued walking up behind her.

The two of them walked up the long steps.

The inner disciples on both sides bowed and gave way, and no one said another word.

If they looked at Zhang Yu with curiosity and suspicion just now, now there is only awe in their eyes.

Breaking through the senior brother's triple protective shield with one sword - not everyone can achieve this strength, let alone among the inner disciples, even among the deacons and elders.

Passing through the last stone steps, an extremely magnificent hall appeared in front.

The main hall is located at the highest point of the mountain, with cliffs on three sides. There is only one stone step leading to the square in front of the hall.

There are five floors in the palace, each floor is taller than the previous one, with cornices and carved beams. Nine strings of golden bells hang on the top eaves, which emit a long and clear sound when the mountain breeze blows by.

There is a huge plaque hanging directly above the palace door, with three large characters - Tianfu Palace - carved on it in powerful ancient seals.

Barrage was amazed again.

[Fu Zong is so impressive today!The mountain gate was already spectacular enough before, but this main hall is even more exaggerated!】

[The sounds of those golden bells are so nice, I feel peaceful even through the screen!】

[I feel like a country bumpkin who comes to the city, everything I see is new!】

Zhang Yu didn't care about the barrage's exclamation.

He followed Ning Shuangxu into the Tianfu Palace.

The space in the temple was wider than he imagined.

There is a long dark red carpet spread in the center of the hall. On both sides of the long carpet stand several middle-aged monks wearing dark blue deacon costumes.

At the innermost end of the hall, there are seven rosewood chairs.The chair in the center is slightly taller than the other six, and the back of the chair is engraved with the Tianfu Sect's sect totem - a talisman pattern composed of countless small runes.

At this moment, there are seven people sitting on those seven chairs.

In the center is an old man.

He looks to be in his early sixties, wearing a purple-gold robe of the sect master. His hair is gray, but he is in good spirits.

A pair of eyes sunken deep into the eye sockets, the pupils of which are a rare dark brown, seeming to be able to see through people when looking at them.

There were three elders sitting on each side of him, both men and women, ranging in age from forty to seventy years old.

The spiritual power fluctuations emanating from everyone are extremely strong, at least they are at the Golden Core stage.

The first person sitting on the left side of the sect master was a white-haired old man with a thin face, high cheekbones, and small eyes, but shining with a cold and stern light.

The spiritual power fluctuations in his body are second only to the sect leader among the seven.

This is the great elder of Tianfu Sect—also Han Yi’s master.
